content.trans: 句子 "phrase to get on stage" 翻译成中文是：

content.text: When I get on stage, I get very nervous.
content.trans: 当我在舞台上讲话时，我感到非常紧张。

content.text: You don't have to say when I get on the stage or she's normally very shy, but when she
content.trans: 你不需要说，当我在舞台上出现或她通常非常害羞时，但当你在后台出现时。

content.text: gets on stage, she opens up and becomes very, very talkative.
content.trans: 英语：她把责任卸下，变得非常、非常活跃。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: All right.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: So that's all the phrases we've picked out for you.
content.trans: 所以，这就是我们为你挑选出来的所有短语。

content.text: Let's listen to our dialogue one last time and we'll be right back.
content.trans: 让我们再听一遍我们的对话，然后我们马上回来。

content.text: Are you excited about your trip next month?
content.trans: 英语：你对下个月的旅行有什么期待吗？

content.text: Yes.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: And no.
content.trans: 而且。

content.text: I can't wait to go to Europe, but at the same time, I'm terrified.
content.trans: 英语：我迫不及待地想去欧洲，但同时又感到害怕。

content.text: Why?
content.trans: 为什么？

content.text: Well, I have aerophobia.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，我有气喘吁吁的感觉。

content.text: I have a chronic fear of flying.
content.trans: 我有慢性恐惧飞行。

content.text: Oh, really?
content.trans: 英语：哦，真的？

content.text: I have an uncle who is also terrified of flying.
content.trans: 我有一个叔叔也害怕飞行。

content.text: It's not that bad though.
content.trans: 英语：它不是那么糟糕。

content.text: I mean, it is pretty scary to be up in this big machine flying through the air.
content.trans: 英语：我指的是，这真是吓人的，要飞到这么高的地方去了。

content.text: It's 700 miles per hour.
content.trans: 英语：它有700英里/小时的速度。

content.text: I actually have arachnophobia.
content.trans: 我实际上对蝎子过敏。

content.text: You're scared of spiders.
content.trans: 你害怕蜘蛛吗？

content.text: I actually have two morphobias, acrophobia and glossophobia.
content.trans: 我实际上有两处恐惧症，比如多疑症和幻觉症。

content.text: I guess that explains why you're afraid of flying, but public speaking is not that bad.
content.trans: 英语：我猜这解释了你为什么害怕飞行，但公共演讲并不那么糟糕。

content.text: Are you kidding?
content.trans: 英语：你这是什么？

content.text: When I get on stage, my palms start to sweat.
content.trans: 当我在舞台上讲话时，我的手开始出汗。

content.text: I get really nervous and I can hardly speak.
content.trans: 我非常紧张，几乎说不出话。

content.text: Well, I must confess that I am a bit claustrophobic.
content.trans: 英语：嗯，我必须承认自己有点紧张。

content.text: I hate being in an elevator for more than five seconds.
content.trans: 我讨厌在电梯里待超过五秒。

content.text: We are such weirdos, right?
content.trans: 我们真是个奇葩，对吧？

content.text: All right.
content.trans: 英语：一切好。

content.text: So talking about all these phobias, now one of these phobias was actually made into a movie
content.trans: 所以谈论这些恐惧，现在这一个恐惧被实际化成了电影。

content.text: I think in 1990, arachnophobia, this very chronic fear of spiders.
content.trans: 英语：我认为在1990年，对蜘蛛这种非常顽固的恐惧。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 正确。

content.text: And I remember when I was younger and this movie came out, everybody started talking about
content.trans: 我记得小时候，这部电影上映后大家都开始谈论……

content.text: how they were arachnophobic.
content.trans: 如何他们对蝎子如此厌恶。

content.text: They had this horrible fear of spiders.
content.trans: 他们对蜘蛛有一种可怕的恐惧。

content.text: Did you ever see that movie?
content.trans: 是的，我曾经看过那个电影。

content.text: Yeah, of course.
content.trans: 是的，当然。

content.text: They terrified.
content.trans: 他们害怕。

content.text: It was supposedly some South American spider that made its way into the United States
content.trans: 据说，是来自南美洲的蜘蛛进入了美国。

content.text: in a box in a crate or something.
content.trans: 在箱子或盒子里。

content.text: Now many people handle phobias differently.
content.trans: 现在很多人处理恐惧的方式不同。

content.text: Do you have any phobia?
content.trans: 英语：你有恐惧症吗？

content.text: Are you claustrophobic?
content.trans: 英语：你是不是很紧张？

content.text: Are you arachnophobic?
content.trans: 是的，你对蜘蛛很害怕。

content.text: I don't have any phobias and I'm not really afraid of anything.
content.trans: 我没有任何恐惧，也不害怕任何事情。

content.text: So I'm pretty lucky that way, but I know a number of people who are afraid of heights,
content.trans: 所以，我挺幸运的，但我知道有很多人害怕高处。

content.text: agrophobic and so that's pretty common.
content.trans: 防寒保暖，所以这是比较常见的。

content.text: And actually if you look it up, you will find in dictionary maybe hundreds of phobias,
content.trans: 而且实际上，如果你查字典，你可能会发现大约上百种恐惧症。

content.text: people who are afraid of open spaces, people who are afraid of closed spaces or people who
content.trans: 人们害怕开放空间的人，人们害怕封闭的空间，或者人们

content.text: are afraid of marriage, they even have a phobia determined for this type of person.
content.trans: 英语：他们甚至有这种类型的恐惧症。

content.text: So it's very interesting.
content.trans: 所以它非常有趣。

content.text: Now this is going to be a challenge.
content.trans: 现在这是要承担重任的。

content.text: Why don't you look up a couple of different phobias and share with us.
content.trans: 英语：为什么你不找一些不同的恐惧症并和我们分享一下。

content.text: Maybe some of the craziest ones or the funniest ones or maybe the strangest ones you can find.
content.trans: 可能有一些最疯狂的，最有趣的或者你找不出的理由之一。

content.text: That's right.
content.trans: 没错。

content.text: So look them up.
content.trans: 所以查查资料。

content.text: Share them with us.
content.trans: 请将它们分享给我们。

content.text: Our website is engluchpa.com.
content.trans: 我们的网站是英伦宝典网。

content.text: All right.
content.trans: 英语：一切好。

content.text: We'll see you guys there.
content.trans: 我们会在那里见你。

content.text: Bye.
content.trans: 拜。
